name: Sela Relay
description: Act 2 opener, chapter `first-light` (STORY.md §16): the `first-light` mission, the first flight to Sela. The grey near side of the moon: a flat landing ground (`landing-flat`, the Core's pad), craters all round, and a big crater to the north-west with the relay mast standing on its south-east rim (`relay-mast`: the Biosphere Report's relay, precursor make, our own packet format). Relic grid `relay` (a node at the mast, three sentinels, a small cache) wakes as we come close and half of it stands down at the handshake. Near the east edge, at the terminator, a dead-straight seam with raised lips runs the whole height of the map: `far-door`, "a door the size of a valley", which can't be opened (the Enclave's map called it the Lid; see `lantern` on the far side). No wildlife (airless moon: no herds, packs ×0, one open spawn with no nest); a long grace. Hooks: `relay-read` at `relay-mast`, `the-door` at `far-door`, `sela-sky` on landing, `engram-hello` on leaving. Still needs: an expedition package (what the lander carries: no starting base, limited alloys).
